column1: # If adapters ever became path-addressable, does the PATH axis hit a ceiling too?
# Today it cannot: every path rule in the generated route keys on the service name
# or the base model name, and neither multiplies by adapter count. Only the two
# header rules grow. Confirmed against the captured route: an adapter has no
# falls through to the neighbour route.
# It is worth asking because on ODH the header family is denied outright, so
# publisher paths are the only authorized way to address a model - which means an
# adapter has no authorized path-based address today.
# Note the byte cap differs by axis: Gateway API sets HTTPPathMatch.Value to
# MaxLength 1024, against HTTPHeaderMatch.Value at 4096. The alternation trick is
# four times weaker on paths than on headers.
